dropdown:
Dropdown

Dropdown repaints the option list: the surface background, the border, and the radius.

Usage 

@uiForm.DualSelectInput(uiForm.DualSelectInputSettings{
	Label:   "Port",
	Options: portOptions,

	// OptionalFields
	ValueTwoWayStatePath: "portValue",
	InputName:            "portValue",

	Dropdown: uiForm.DualSelectInputDropdownStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "violet-900",
		BorderColor:     "violet-500/40",
		BorderRadius:    uiToolset.BorderRadiusLg,
	},
})

invalid-state:
Invalid State

IsInvalidOneWayStatePath takes an Alpine expression. While it is true the border turns red and both halves carry aria-invalid.

Usage 

@uiForm.DualSelectInput(uiForm.DualSelectInputSettings{
	Label:   "Port",
	Options: portOptions,

	// OptionalFields
	SelectTwoWayStatePath:    "portUnit",
	ValueTwoWayStatePath:     "portValue",
	InputName:                "portValue",
	IsInvalidOneWayStatePath: "portValue > 65535",
})

number-value:
Number Value

InputType takes a uiForm.InputType constant. SelectName and InputName submit the two halves as separate form fields.

Usage 

@uiForm.DualSelectInput(uiForm.DualSelectInputSettings{
	Label:   "Timeout",
	Options: timeoutOptions,

	// OptionalFields
	InputType:            uiForm.InputTypeNumber,
	SelectTwoWayStatePath: "timeoutUnit",
	ValueTwoWayStatePath:  "timeoutValue",
	InputName:             "timeoutValue",
	SelectName:            "timeoutUnit",
})

shared-slot:
Shared Slot

Leave SelectTwoWayStatePath empty to bind both halves to ValueTwoWayStatePath. A preset pick writes the slot, and a typed value that matches no option shows Custom.

Usage 

@uiForm.DualSelectInput(uiForm.DualSelectInputSettings{
	Label:   "Minute",
	Options: minuteOptions,

	// OptionalFields
	ValueTwoWayStatePath: "minute",
	InputName:            "minute",
})

sizes:
Sizes

Size takes an InputFieldSize constant and scales the input, the select, and the label together: xs, sm, md (the default), lg, or xl.

Usage 

@uiForm.DualSelectInput(uiForm.DualSelectInputSettings{
	Label:   "Port",
	Options: portOptions,

	// OptionalFields
	Size:                 uiForm.InputFieldSizeLg,
	ValueTwoWayStatePath: "portValue",
	InputName:            "portValue",
})

style:
Style

Field repaints the shared surface: the background, the border, the radius, the divider between the halves, and the text.

Usage 

@uiForm.DualSelectInput(uiForm.DualSelectInputSettings{
	Label:   "Port",
	Options: portOptions,

	// OptionalFields
	SelectTwoWayStatePath: "portUnit",
	ValueTwoWayStatePath:  "portValue",
	Field: uiForm.DualSelectInputFieldStyle{
		BackgroundColor: "violet-950",
		BorderColor:     "violet-500/40",
		BorderRadius:    uiToolset.BorderRadiusLg,
		DividerColor:    "violet-500/30",
		TextColor:       "violet-100",
	},
})
